paragraphs: Hyman reports that in Kaftor va-Ferach, chapter 10, page 184b, Luncz edition, the reading at Temurah 29a is “Beta said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan”; his editions of the Gemara read Baha [בהא].[^1][^2]

notes.text: Beta [בתא] is the Kaftor va-Ferach reading reported by Hyman; the consulted Temurah text names Baha [בהא].
Hyman reports the Kaftor va-Ferach/Luncz reading; that edition has not been collated here. The consulted Temurah 29a paragraphs explicitly name Baha and Rabbi Yochanan.
